Subject: Vendor setup: initial onboarding docs + PO request

Hi Aditya,

Thanks for the demo last week — NebulaBiz is ready to move forward with Redwood for inference serving for our customer analytics pipeline. Procurement asked me to send over the onboarding packet so we can get a PO and spend cap in place.

Attached: onboarding checklist (partial) and a current line item export from our ERP. There are two line items that need to be split on your side: "Model Serving (monthly)" should be split into a base license + token overage SKU, and "Support" should be mapped to the enterprise support SKU.

Key asks:
- Can you confirm what fields you need on your onboarding form to generate a PO? (tax ID, remit address, vendor code?)
- Estimated start date: June 1. Can you provision a provisional PO or temporary spend cap so we can start ramping usage?
- Any required procurement docs (W-9, SOC2 attestation) we should upload now?

Jamie Ross
Procurement Lead, NebulaBiz
jamie.ross@nebulabiz.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

Jamie — thanks, received. Looping in Monica (procurement ops) and Markus (finance) to get the provisioning process started. A few quick clarifying points so we don't have to back-and-forth: 

1) Onboarding form: we need the vendor legal name, W-9 (if US), billing remit address, vendor tax ID/EIN, and preferred invoice cadence. If NebulaBiz is using a billing contact, include that too.

2) SKU mapping: Monica, can you take the attached line item CSV and produce the two SKUs Aditya mentioned (base-license + token-overage) and one enterprise-support SKU? If you need a mapping template, I'll attach our SKU map.

3) Provisional PO / temporary spend cap: Markus, do we have a standard provisional PO (30–60d) we can issue to allow June 1 start while procurement finishes the full PO? If so, what's the default spend cap we should set for a pilot (we discussed $25k/month on the demo)?

Jamie — if you can upload the completed onboarding PDF (with W-9) and sign the vendor agreement link I sent during the demo, we can accelerate. I'm attaching the SKU mapping template and our provisional PO template for reference.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Enterprise AE — Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.com | +1 (650) 555-0123
